mapper.insert: INSERT INTO balance (balance_id, account_id, currency, available_amount) VALUES (#{balanceId, javaType=java.util.UUID}, #{accountId, javaType=java.util.UUID}, #{currency}, #{availableAmount})

mapper.select: SELECT balance_id, account_id, currency, available_amount FROM balance WHERE account_id = #{accountId, javaType=java.util.UUID} ORDER BY currency
